# [TASK] Filmpire React app integration: env base URL, CORS verification, runbook

## Task
Point the existing React app (`frontend/filmpire`) at this backend instead of real TMDB, with the smallest possible code diff, and prove it actually works end-to-end. Scope grew past the original title as click-through testing surfaced real bugs and the login/favorites/watchlist flow was rewired to Filmpire's own user-service.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `src/services/TMDB.js` reads `REACT_APP_API_URL`, falling back to real TMDB when unset; `.env.local`/`.env.example` and a runbook (`docs/guides/RUN_WITH_FILMPIRE_APP.md`) document it
- [x] Home page, movie detail, actor page, genre browsing, search, and CORS from `localhost:3000` confirmed working end-to-end via automated click-through (headless Chrome), not just curl
- [x] Login, favorites, and watchlist rewired from TMDB's real session flow to Filmpire's own user-service (register/login/JWT, favorites/watchlist by movieId); `LoginDialog` replaces the old redirect-to-themoviedb.org button — verified live: register -> favorite a movie -> shows on Profile
- [x] Real click-through testing found and fixed 5 live bugs: movie-detail crash on list-sourced movies (2deaeb2), trailer-modal crash on zero-video movies (8c41243), double-slash in the recommendations URL (f6ae35d), duplicate CORS header on the auth/account proxy (0ad44e0), Redis serialization crash on actor detail (4b84d7d)
- [x] Voice commands (self-hosted Vosk speech-to-text, replacing a dead Alan AI integration — tracked separately as #68/#69) tested with a real microphone: dark/light mode and category/genre/actor search confirmed working; voice login correctly left out of scope (can't supply credentials by voice)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 16

## Notes
`src/utils/index.js` also read `REACT_APP_API_URL` at one point (commit 717a819) but was later repurposed to JWT-pair storage by the user-service rewire (74ca9ce) — `TMDB.js` is the only base-URL read site now.
